original_forecast.resolution_rule: Up-event succeeds if the official/index-provider or consistently sourced S&P 500 close on 2026-08-12 exceeds the 2026-08-11 close of 7,728.20. Resolve the point and 80% interval against the same close source.
rationale: The July CPI release is a high-information event with consensus pointing to modest headline/core cooling, giving a slight upside lean if the print is benign.
The persistent oil/supply shock keeps a meaningful hotter-inflation and higher-yield downside tail alive.
The Aug. 11 decline was modest and small caps were resilient, so the model does not infer broad recessionary risk-off momentum from one session.
surprising_if: SPX moves more than 2.5% with CPI near consensus and without a large yield/geopolitical move.
SPX closes outside the stated 80% interval.

resolution.source: Reuters, 2026-08-12 U.S. market close: S&P 500 closed at 7,748.50, up 0.26%.
resolution.audit_note: Forecast content above is preserved verbatim. The up-event resolved true, the point estimate missed by 8.50 points, and the 80% interval covered. The point estimate beat both listed point benchmarks. This resolution was scored before any Aug. 12 evidence was used for model revision; the sample remains too small for a learning claim.
